{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# gh-848 — Root Cause Analysis

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The gh-748 twin-guard cancel path (`cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` in `js/smAgent.js`) cancels workflow runs while they are still `queued` (pre-materialization). A queued cancel leaves the run's already-registered check-runs orphaned as `in_progress` ghosts forever — no run exists to re-run, and the tick PAT cannot conclude them via the Checks API (403, verified) — so branch protection holds mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED on dead check-runs indefinitely.

**Root cause**: `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` (js/smAgent.js) selected stale runs (`status === 'queued' | 'in_progress' | 'waiting' | 'pending'`) and issued `gh api -X POST .../actions/runs/<id>/cancel` with no materialization check. A run's check-suite registers at dispatch time (ghost #5: dispatch 21:39:48, check-suite 21:40:01) while the jobs only materialize later; GitHub only concludes a run's check-runs as `cancelled` when jobs exist. Cancel in the queued window = orphaned `in_progress` check-runs (live fa #1457 five ghost cycles, fa #1520, ghosts #4–#6 on 2026-10-10, AFTER the gh-843 cure side went live — the cure detects ghosts but cannot prevent this minter).

**Impact**: Every validated machine PR is at risk. A single duplicate/superseded dispatch cancelled within seconds of its dispatch seizes the merge gate permanently (2h+ operator cost per incident on fa #1457).

**Fix approach** (per ticket capability surface):
1. **Guard** — before `gh run cancel`, poll `gh api .../actions/runs/<id>` until `run.status != 'queued'` (jobs materialized) with a short timeout (`jobParams.cancelMaterializeTimeoutMs`, default 45s; `jobParams.cancelMaterializePollMs`, default 3s). Still queued (or probe degenerate) → DEFER the cancel to the next tick. A materialized cancel marks check-runs `cancelled` — a clean terminal state.
2. **Belt** — after ANY cancel, list the cancelled run's check-runs on its head (`github_get_commit_check_runs`, filtered by backing run id via `checkRunZombies.runIdOf`); any still pending is concluded `cancelled` via the Checks API (`PATCH /check-runs/<id>`) under the GitHub App token swap (`jobParams.silentToken` — PAT 403s, same swap `stampValidationChecksForModule` already uses).
3. **Audit** — one marker comment per head per event (`⏸ ghost-guard defer <sha> — run <id> still queued at <iso>` / `🧹 ghost-guard clean <sha> — <N> orphaned check-run(s) concluded at <iso>`), deduped against existing markers so a head sitting queued across many ticks produces exactly one comment, never one per tick.

**Previous attempt**: none (fresh bug; gh-843 cure side already shipped and intentionally out of scope).
"}

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# gh-848 — Root Cause Analysis

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The gh-748 twin-guard cancel path (`cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` in `js/smAgent.js`) cancels workflow runs while they are still `queued` (pre-materialization). A queued cancel leaves the run's already-registered check-runs orphaned as `in_progress` ghosts forever — no run exists to re-run, and the tick PAT cannot conclude them via the Checks API (403, verified) — so branch protection holds mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED on dead check-runs indefinitely.

**Root cause**: `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` (js/smAgent.js) selected stale runs (`status === 'queued' | 'in_progress' | 'waiting' | 'pending'`) and issued `gh api -X POST .../actions/runs/<id>/cancel` with no materialization check. A run's check-suite registers at dispatch time (ghost #5: dispatch 21:39:48, check-suite 21:40:01) while the jobs only materialize later; GitHub only concludes a run's check-runs as `cancelled` when jobs exist. Cancel in the queued window = orphaned `in_progress` check-runs (live fa #1457 five ghost cycles, fa #1520, ghosts #4–#6 on 2026-10-10, AFTER the gh-843 cure side went live — the cure detects ghosts but cannot prevent this minter).

**Impact**: Every validated machine PR is at risk. A single duplicate/superseded dispatch cancelled within seconds of its dispatch seizes the merge gate permanently (2h+ operator cost per incident on fa #1457).

**Fix approach** (per ticket capability surface):
1. **Guard** — before `gh run cancel`, poll `gh api .../actions/runs/<id>` until `run.status != 'queued'` (jobs materialized) with a short timeout (`jobParams.cancelMaterializeTimeoutMs`, default 45s; `jobParams.cancelMaterializePollMs`, default 3s). Still queued (or probe degenerate) → DEFER the cancel to the next tick. A materialized cancel marks check-runs `cancelled` — a clean terminal state.
2. **Belt** — after ANY cancel, list the cancelled run's check-runs on its head (`github_get_commit_check_runs`, filtered by backing run id via `checkRunZombies.runIdOf`); any still pending is concluded `cancelled` via the Checks API (`PATCH /check-runs/<id>`) under the GitHub App token swap (`jobParams.silentToken` — PAT 403s, same swap `stampValidationChecksForModule` already uses).
3. **Audit** — one marker comment per head per event (`⏸ ghost-guard defer <sha> — run <id> still queued at <iso>` / `🧹 ghost-guard clean <sha> — <N> orphaned check-run(s) concluded at <iso>`), deduped against existing markers so a head sitting queued across many ticks produces exactly one comment, never one per tick.

**Previous attempt**: none (fresh bug; gh-843 cure side already shipped and intentionally out of scope).
"}

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# gh-848 — Root Cause Analysis

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The gh-748 twin-guard cancel path (`cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` in `js/smAgent.js`) cancels workflow runs while they are still `queued` (pre-materialization). A queued cancel leaves the run's already-registered check-runs orphaned as `in_progress` ghosts forever — no run exists to re-run, and the tick PAT cannot conclude them via the Checks API (403, verified) — so branch protection holds mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED on dead check-runs indefinitely.

**Root cause**: `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` (js/smAgent.js) selected stale runs (`status === 'queued' | 'in_progress' | 'waiting' | 'pending'`) and issued `gh api -X POST .../actions/runs/<id>/cancel` with no materialization check. A run's check-suite registers at dispatch time (ghost #5: dispatch 21:39:48, check-suite 21:40:01) while the jobs only materialize later; GitHub only concludes a run's check-runs as `cancelled` when jobs exist. Cancel in the queued window = orphaned `in_progress` check-runs (live fa #1457 five ghost cycles, fa #1520, ghosts #4–#6 on 2026-10-10, AFTER the gh-843 cure side went live — the cure detects ghosts but cannot prevent this minter).

**Impact**: Every validated machine PR is at risk. A single duplicate/superseded dispatch cancelled within seconds of its dispatch seizes the merge gate permanently (2h+ operator cost per incident on fa #1457).

**Fix approach** (per ticket capability surface):
1. **Guard** — before `gh run cancel`, poll `gh api .../actions/runs/<id>` until `run.status != 'queued'` (jobs materialized) with a short timeout (`jobParams.cancelMaterializeTimeoutMs`, default 45s; `jobParams.cancelMaterializePollMs`, default 3s). Still queued (or probe degenerate) → DEFER the cancel to the next tick. A materialized cancel marks check-runs `cancelled` — a clean terminal state.
2. **Belt** — after ANY cancel, list the cancelled run's check-runs on its head (`github_get_commit_check_runs`, filtered by backing run id via `checkRunZombies.runIdOf`); any still pending is concluded `cancelled` via the Checks API (`PATCH /check-runs/<id>`) under the GitHub App token swap (`jobParams.silentToken` — PAT 403s, same swap `stampValidationChecksForModule` already uses).
3. **Audit** — one marker comment per head per event (`⏸ ghost-guard defer <sha> — run <id> still queued at <iso>` / `🧹 ghost-guard clean <sha> — <N> orphaned check-run(s) concluded at <iso>`), deduped against existing markers so a head sitting queued across many ticks produces exactly one comment, never one per tick.

**Previous attempt**: none (fresh bug; gh-843 cure side already shipped and intentionally out of scope).

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# gh-848 — Root Cause Analysis

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The gh-748 twin-guard cancel path (`cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` in `js/smAgent.js`) cancels workflow runs while they are still `queued` (pre-materialization). A queued cancel leaves the run's already-registered check-runs orphaned as `in_progress` ghosts forever — no run exists to re-run, and the tick PAT cannot conclude them via the Checks API (403, verified) — so branch protection holds mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED on dead check-runs indefinitely.

**Root cause**: `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` (js/smAgent.js) selected stale runs (`status === 'queued' | 'in_progress' | 'waiting' | 'pending'`) and issued `gh api -X POST .../actions/runs/<id>/cancel` with no materialization check. A run's check-suite registers at dispatch time (ghost #5: dispatch 21:39:48, check-suite 21:40:01) while the jobs only materialize later; GitHub only concludes a run's check-runs as `cancelled` when jobs exist. Cancel in the queued window = orphaned `in_progress` check-runs (live fa #1457 five ghost cycles, fa #1520, ghosts #4–#6 on 2026-10-10, AFTER the gh-843 cure side went live — the cure detects ghosts but cannot prevent this minter).

**Impact**: Every validated machine PR is at risk. A single duplicate/superseded dispatch cancelled within seconds of its dispatch seizes the merge gate permanently (2h+ operator cost per incident on fa #1457).

**Fix approach** (per ticket capability surface):
1. **Guard** — before `gh run cancel`, poll `gh api .../actions/runs/<id>` until `run.status != 'queued'` (jobs materialized) with a short timeout (`jobParams.cancelMaterializeTimeoutMs`, default 45s; `jobParams.cancelMaterializePollMs`, default 3s). Still queued (or probe degenerate) → DEFER the cancel to the next tick. A materialized cancel marks check-runs `cancelled` — a clean terminal state.
2. **Belt** — after ANY cancel, list the cancelled run's check-runs on its head (`github_get_commit_check_runs`, filtered by backing run id via `checkRunZombies.runIdOf`); any still pending is concluded `cancelled` via the Checks API (`PATCH /check-runs/<id>`) under the GitHub App token swap (`jobParams.silentToken` — PAT 403s, same swap `stampValidationChecksForModule` already uses).
3. **Audit** — one marker comment per head per event (`⏸ ghost-guard defer <sha> — run <id> still queued at <iso>` / `🧹 ghost-guard clean <sha> — <N> orphaned check-run(s) concluded at <iso>`), deduped against existing markers so a head sitting queued across many ticks produces exactly one comment, never one per tick.

**Previous attempt**: none (fresh bug; gh-843 cure side already shipped and intentionally out of scope).
"}

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# gh-848 — Root Cause Analysis

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The gh-748 twin-guard cancel path (`cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` in `js/smAgent.js`) cancels workflow runs while they are still `queued` (pre-materialization). A queued cancel leaves the run's already-registered check-runs orphaned as `in_progress` ghosts forever — no run exists to re-run, and the tick PAT cannot conclude them via the Checks API (403, verified) — so branch protection holds mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED on dead check-runs indefinitely.

**Root cause**: `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` (js/smAgent.js) selected stale runs (`status === 'queued' | 'in_progress' | 'waiting' | 'pending'`) and issued `gh api -X POST .../actions/runs/<id>/cancel` with no materialization check. A run's check-suite registers at dispatch time (ghost #5: dispatch 21:39:48, check-suite 21:40:01) while the jobs only materialize later; GitHub only concludes a run's check-runs as `cancelled` when jobs exist. Cancel in the queued window = orphaned `in_progress` check-runs (live fa #1457 five ghost cycles, fa #1520, ghosts #4–#6 on 2026-10-10, AFTER the gh-843 cure side went live — the cure detects ghosts but cannot prevent this minter).

**Impact**: Every validated machine PR is at risk. A single duplicate/superseded dispatch cancelled within seconds of its dispatch seizes the merge gate permanently (2h+ operator cost per incident on fa #1457).

**Fix approach** (per ticket capability surface):
1. **Guard** — before `gh run cancel`, poll `gh api .../actions/runs/<id>` until `run.status != 'queued'` (jobs materialized) with a short timeout (`jobParams.cancelMaterializeTimeoutMs`, default 45s; `jobParams.cancelMaterializePollMs`, default 3s). Still queued (or probe degenerate) → DEFER the cancel to the next tick. A materialized cancel marks check-runs `cancelled` — a clean terminal state.
2. **Belt** — after ANY cancel, list the cancelled run's check-runs on its head (`github_get_commit_check_runs`, filtered by backing run id via `checkRunZombies.runIdOf`); any still pending is concluded `cancelled` via the Checks API (`PATCH /check-runs/<id>`) under the GitHub App token swap (`jobParams.silentToken` — PAT 403s, same swap `stampValidationChecksForModule` already uses).
3. **Audit** — one marker comment per head per event (`⏸ ghost-guard defer <sha> — run <id> still queued at <iso>` / `🧹 ghost-guard clean <sha> — <N> orphaned check-run(s) concluded at <iso>`), deduped against existing markers so a head sitting queued across many ticks produces exactly one comment, never one per tick.

**Previous attempt**: none (fresh bug; gh-843 cure side already shipped and intentionally out of scope).
"}

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# gh-848 — Root Cause Analysis

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The gh-748 twin-guard cancel path (`cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` in `js/smAgent.js`) cancels workflow runs while they are still `queued` (pre-materialization). A queued cancel leaves the run's already-registered check-runs orphaned as `in_progress` ghosts forever — no run exists to re-run, and the tick PAT cannot conclude them via the Checks API (403, verified) — so branch protection holds mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED on dead check-runs indefinitely.

**Root cause**: `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` (js/smAgent.js) selected stale runs (`status === 'queued' | 'in_progress' | 'waiting' | 'pending'`) and issued `gh api -X POST .../actions/runs/<id>/cancel` with no materialization check. A run's check-suite registers at dispatch time (ghost #5: dispatch 21:39:48, check-suite 21:40:01) while the jobs only materialize later; GitHub only concludes a run's check-runs as `cancelled` when jobs exist. Cancel in the queued window = orphaned `in_progress` check-runs (live fa #1457 five ghost cycles, fa #1520, ghosts #4–#6 on 2026-10-10, AFTER the gh-843 cure side went live — the cure detects ghosts but cannot prevent this minter).

**Impact**: Every validated machine PR is at risk. A single duplicate/superseded dispatch cancelled within seconds of its dispatch seizes the merge gate permanently (2h+ operator cost per incident on fa #1457).

**Fix approach** (per ticket capability surface):
1. **Guard** — before `gh run cancel`, poll `gh api .../actions/runs/<id>` until `run.status != 'queued'` (jobs materialized) with a short timeout (`jobParams.cancelMaterializeTimeoutMs`, default 45s; `jobParams.cancelMaterializePollMs`, default 3s). Still queued (or probe degenerate) → DEFER the cancel to the next tick. A materialized cancel marks check-runs `cancelled` — a clean terminal state.
2. **Belt** — after ANY cancel, list the cancelled run's check-runs on its head (`github_get_commit_check_runs`, filtered by backing run id via `checkRunZombies.runIdOf`); any still pending is concluded `cancelled` via the Checks API (`PATCH /check-runs/<id>`) under the GitHub App token swap (`jobParams.silentToken` — PAT 403s, same swap `stampValidationChecksForModule` already uses).
3. **Audit** — one marker comment per head per event (`⏸ ghost-guard defer <sha> — run <id> still queued at <iso>` / `🧹 ghost-guard clean <sha> — <N> orphaned check-run(s) concluded at <iso>`), deduped against existing markers so a head sitting queued across many ticks produces exactly one comment, never one per tick.

**Previous attempt**: none (fresh bug; gh-843 cure side already shipped and intentionally out of scope).

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# gh-848 — Root Cause Analysis

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The gh-748 twin-guard cancel path (`cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` in `js/smAgent.js`) cancels workflow runs while they are still `queued` (pre-materialization). A queued cancel leaves the run's already-registered check-runs orphaned as `in_progress` ghosts forever — no run exists to re-run, and the tick PAT cannot conclude them via the Checks API (403, verified) — so branch protection holds mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED on dead check-runs indefinitely.

**Root cause**: `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` (js/smAgent.js) selected stale runs (`status === 'queued' | 'in_progress' | 'waiting' | 'pending'`) and issued `gh api -X POST .../actions/runs/<id>/cancel` with no materialization check. A run's check-suite registers at dispatch time (ghost #5: dispatch 21:39:48, check-suite 21:40:01) while the jobs only materialize later; GitHub only concludes a run's check-runs as `cancelled` when jobs exist. Cancel in the queued window = orphaned `in_progress` check-runs (live fa #1457 five ghost cycles, fa #1520, ghosts #4–#6 on 2026-10-10, AFTER the gh-843 cure side went live — the cure detects ghosts but cannot prevent this minter).

**Impact**: Every validated machine PR is at risk. A single duplicate/superseded dispatch cancelled within seconds of its dispatch seizes the merge gate permanently (2h+ operator cost per incident on fa #1457).

**Fix approach** (per ticket capability surface):
1. **Guard** — before `gh run cancel`, poll `gh api .../actions/runs/<id>` until `run.status != 'queued'` (jobs materialized) with a short timeout (`jobParams.cancelMaterializeTimeoutMs`, default 45s; `jobParams.cancelMaterializePollMs`, default 3s). Still queued (or probe degenerate) → DEFER the cancel to the next tick. A materialized cancel marks check-runs `cancelled` — a clean terminal state.
2. **Belt** — after ANY cancel, list the cancelled run's check-runs on its head (`github_get_commit_check_runs`, filtered by backing run id via `checkRunZombies.runIdOf`); any still pending is concluded `cancelled` via the Checks API (`PATCH /check-runs/<id>`) under the GitHub App token swap (`jobParams.silentToken` — PAT 403s, same swap `stampValidationChecksForModule` already uses).
3. **Audit** — one marker comment per head per event (`⏸ ghost-guard defer <sha> — run <id> still queued at <iso>` / `🧹 ghost-guard clean <sha> — <N> orphaned check-run(s) concluded at <iso>`), deduped against existing markers so a head sitting queued across many ticks produces exactly one comment, never one per tick.

**Previous attempt**: none (fresh bug; gh-843 cure side already shipped and intentionally out of scope).
"}

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# gh-848 — Root Cause Analysis

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The gh-748 twin-guard cancel path (`cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` in `js/smAgent.js`) cancels workflow runs while they are still `queued` (pre-materialization). A queued cancel leaves the run's already-registered check-runs orphaned as `in_progress` ghosts forever — no run exists to re-run, and the tick PAT cannot conclude them via the Checks API (403, verified) — so branch protection holds mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED on dead check-runs indefinitely.

**Root cause**: `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` (js/smAgent.js) selected stale runs (`status === 'queued' | 'in_progress' | 'waiting' | 'pending'`) and issued `gh api -X POST .../actions/runs/<id>/cancel` with no materialization check. A run's check-suite registers at dispatch time (ghost #5: dispatch 21:39:48, check-suite 21:40:01) while the jobs only materialize later; GitHub only concludes a run's check-runs as `cancelled` when jobs exist. Cancel in the queued window = orphaned `in_progress` check-runs (live fa #1457 five ghost cycles, fa #1520, ghosts #4–#6 on 2026-10-10, AFTER the gh-843 cure side went live — the cure detects ghosts but cannot prevent this minter).

**Impact**: Every validated machine PR is at risk. A single duplicate/superseded dispatch cancelled within seconds of its dispatch seizes the merge gate permanently (2h+ operator cost per incident on fa #1457).

**Fix approach** (per ticket capability surface):
1. **Guard** — before `gh run cancel`, poll `gh api .../actions/runs/<id>` until `run.status != 'queued'` (jobs materialized) with a short timeout (`jobParams.cancelMaterializeTimeoutMs`, default 45s; `jobParams.cancelMaterializePollMs`, default 3s). Still queued (or probe degenerate) → DEFER the cancel to the next tick. A materialized cancel marks check-runs `cancelled` — a clean terminal state.
2. **Belt** — after ANY cancel, list the cancelled run's check-runs on its head (`github_get_commit_check_runs`, filtered by backing run id via `checkRunZombies.runIdOf`); any still pending is concluded `cancelled` via the Checks API (`PATCH /check-runs/<id>`) under the GitHub App token swap (`jobParams.silentToken` — PAT 403s, same swap `stampValidationChecksForModule` already uses).
3. **Audit** — one marker comment per head per event (`⏸ ghost-guard defer <sha> — run <id> still queued at <iso>` / `🧹 ghost-guard clean <sha> — <N> orphaned check-run(s) concluded at <iso>`), deduped against existing markers so a head sitting queued across many ticks produces exactly one comment, never one per tick.

**Previous attempt**: none (fresh bug; gh-843 cure side already shipped and intentionally out of scope).
"}

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# gh-848 — Root Cause Analysis

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The gh-748 twin-guard cancel path (`cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` in `js/smAgent.js`) cancels workflow runs while they are still `queued` (pre-materialization). A queued cancel leaves the run's already-registered check-runs orphaned as `in_progress` ghosts forever — no run exists to re-run, and the tick PAT cannot conclude them via the Checks API (403, verified) — so branch protection holds mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED on dead check-runs indefinitely.

**Root cause**: `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` (js/smAgent.js) selected stale runs (`status === 'queued' | 'in_progress' | 'waiting' | 'pending'`) and issued `gh api -X POST .../actions/runs/<id>/cancel` with no materialization check. A run's check-suite registers at dispatch time (ghost #5: dispatch 21:39:48, check-suite 21:40:01) while the jobs only materialize later; GitHub only concludes a run's check-runs as `cancelled` when jobs exist. Cancel in the queued window = orphaned `in_progress` check-runs (live fa #1457 five ghost cycles, fa #1520, ghosts #4–#6 on 2026-10-10, AFTER the gh-843 cure side went live — the cure detects ghosts but cannot prevent this minter).

**Impact**: Every validated machine PR is at risk. A single duplicate/superseded dispatch cancelled within seconds of its dispatch seizes the merge gate permanently (2h+ operator cost per incident on fa #1457).

**Fix approach** (per ticket capability surface):
1. **Guard** — before `gh run cancel`, poll `gh api .../actions/runs/<id>` until `run.status != 'queued'` (jobs materialized) with a short timeout (`jobParams.cancelMaterializeTimeoutMs`, default 45s; `jobParams.cancelMaterializePollMs`, default 3s). Still queued (or probe degenerate) → DEFER the cancel to the next tick. A materialized cancel marks check-runs `cancelled` — a clean terminal state.
2. **Belt** — after ANY cancel, list the cancelled run's check-runs on its head (`github_get_commit_check_runs`, filtered by backing run id via `checkRunZombies.runIdOf`); any still pending is concluded `cancelled` via the Checks API (`PATCH /check-runs/<id>`) under the GitHub App token swap (`jobParams.silentToken` — PAT 403s, same swap `stampValidationChecksForModule` already uses).
3. **Audit** — one marker comment per head per event (`⏸ ghost-guard defer <sha> — run <id> still queued at <iso>` / `🧹 ghost-guard clean <sha> — <N> orphaned check-run(s) concluded at <iso>`), deduped against existing markers so a head sitting queued across many ticks produces exactly one comment, never one per tick.

**Previous attempt**: none (fresh bug; gh-843 cure side already shipped and intentionally out of scope).
"}

arguments.content:
### Root Cause

The gh-748 twin-guard cancel path (`cancelStaleDispatchedRuns`) cancelled stale workflow runs while they were still `queued` (pre-materialization). A run's check-suite registers at dispatch time but jobs materialize later — GitHub only concludes a cancelled run's check-runs `cancelled` when jobs exist. A queued cancel therefore orphans the registered check-runs as `in_progress` ghosts forever (no run to re-run, no API to conclude them with the PAT), seizing mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED (live fa #1457 five ghost cycles, #1520; ghosts #4-#6 on 2026-10-10, after the gh-843 cure side went live).

### Fix

- `js/smAgent.js` — **guard**: before `gh run cancel`, poll `gh api .../actions/runs/<id>` until `status != 'queued'` (jobs materialized) within `jobParams.cancelMaterializeTimeoutMs` (default 45s, poll 3s); still queued or probe-degenerate → **defer** the cancel to the next tick. Probe errors also defer — queue waste is always cheaper than a seized gate.
- `js/smAgent.js` — **belt**: after ANY cancel, list the cancelled run's check-runs on its head (`checkRunZombies.runIdOf` matching); any still pending is concluded `cancelled` via `PATCH /check-runs/<id>` under the GitHub App token swap (`silentToken` — the PAT gets 403, verified), mirroring `stampValidationChecksForModule`.
- `js/smAgent.js` + `js/common/validationLiveness.js` — **audit**: one marker comment per head per event (`⏸ ghost-guard defer …` / `🧹 ghost-guard clean …`), deduped against existing markers so a head queued across many ticks gets exactly one comment. Bookkeeping-only (gh-755 parity: `cancelled` is never a verdict).
- Supersedes the gh-846 same-tick cancel of *queued* runs — AC3 holds: duplicates are still suppressed, just safely.

### Test Coverage

- RED verified: the 4 new reproduction tests FAIL against the pre-fix code (queued run cancelled immediately, no belt, no audit).
- `test_smAgent.js` — 5 new/rewritten cases: defer on queued (ghost-window replay), cancel after materialization, belt concludes only the cancelled run's pending check-runs (App-token swap asserted), multi-run sweep (queued deferred + in_progress cancelled), audit dedupe per head.
- `test_validationLiveness.js` — 4 marker round-trip/parse/degeneracy cases.
- Full suite: **2504 passed, 0 failed**.

### Notes

- Tunables: `jobParams.cancelMaterializeTimeoutMs = 0` restores the legacy cancel-immediately escape hatch.
- Deferral cost: a superseded run may keep occupying the queue until its jobs materialize (one or more ticks) — accepted by design; the gh-842/843 cure-side sweep remains the general ghost backstop.

**Bug**: The gh-748 twin-guard cancel path (`cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` in `js/smAgent.js`) cancels workflow runs while they are still `queued` (pre-materialization). **Root cause**: `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` (js/smAgent.js) selected stale runs (`status === 'queued' | 'in_progress' | 'waiting' | 'pending'`) and issued `gh api -X POST .../actions/runs/<id>/cancel` with no materialization check. A run's check-suite registers at dispatch time (ghost #5: dispatch 21:39:48, check-suite 21:40:01) while the jobs only materialize later; GitHub only concludes a run's check-runs as `cancelled` when jobs exist. Cancel in the queued window = orphaned `in_progress` check-runs (live fa #1457 five ghost cycles, fa #1520, ghosts #4–#6 on 2026-10-10, AFTER the gh-843 cure side went live — the cure detects ghosts but cannot prevent this minter).

**Impact**: Every validated machine PR is at risk. A single duplicate/superseded dispatch cancelled within seconds of its dispatch seizes the merge gate permanently (2h+ operator cost per incident on fa #1457).

**Fix approach** (per ticket capability surface):
1. **Guard** — before `gh run cancel`, poll `gh api .../actions/runs/<id>` until `run.status != 'queued'` (jobs materialized) with a short timeout (`jobParams.cancelMaterializeTimeoutMs`, default 45s; `jobParams.cancelMaterializePollMs`, default 3s). Still queued (or probe degenerate) → DEFER the cancel to the next tick. A materialized cancel marks check-runs `cancelled` — a clean terminal state.
2. **Belt** — after ANY cancel, list the cancelled run's check-runs on its head (`github_get_commit_check_runs`, filtered by backing run id via `checkRunZombies.runIdOf`); any still pending is concluded `cancelled` via the Checks API (`PATCH /check-runs/<id>`) under the GitHub App token swap (`jobParams.silentToken` — PAT 403s, same swap `stampValidationChecksForModule` already uses).
3. **Audit** — one marker comment per head per event (`⏸ ghost-guard defer <sha> — run <id> still queued at <iso>` / `🧹 ghost-guard clean <sha> — <N> orphaned check-run(s) concluded at <iso>`), deduped against existing markers so a head sitting queued across many ticks produces exactly one comment, never one per tick.

{"content":"### Root Cause

The gh-748 twin-guard cancel path (`cancelStaleDispatchedRuns`) cancelled stale workflow runs while they were still `queued` (pre-materialization). A run's check-suite registers at dispatch time but jobs materialize later — GitHub only concludes a cancelled run's check-runs `cancelled` when jobs exist. A queued cancel therefore orphans the registered check-runs as `in_progress` ghosts forever (no run to re-run, no API to conclude them with the PAT), seizing mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED (live fa #1457 five ghost cycles, #1520; ghosts #4-#6 on 2026-10-10, after the gh-843 cure side went live).

### Fix

- `js/smAgent.js` — **guard**: before `gh run cancel`, poll `gh api .../actions/runs/<id>` until `status != 'queued'` (jobs materialized) within `jobParams.cancelMaterializeTimeoutMs` (default 45s, poll 3s); still queued or probe-degenerate → **defer** the cancel to the next tick. Probe errors also defer — queue waste is always cheaper than a seized gate.
- `js/smAgent.js` — **belt**: after ANY cancel, list the cancelled run's check-runs on its head (`checkRunZombies.runIdOf` matching); any still pending is concluded `cancelled` via `PATCH /check-runs/<id>` under the GitHub App token swap (`silentToken` — the PAT gets 403, verified), mirroring `stampValidationChecksForModule`.
- `js/smAgent.js` + `js/common/validationLiveness.js` — **audit**: one marker comment per head per event (`⏸ ghost-guard defer …` / `🧹 ghost-guard clean …`), deduped against existing markers so a head queued across many ticks gets exactly one comment. Bookkeeping-only (gh-755 parity: `cancelled` is never a verdict).
- Supersedes the gh-846 same-tick cancel of *queued* runs — AC3 holds: duplicates are still suppressed, just safely.

### Test Coverage

- RED verified: the 4 new reproduction tests FAIL against the pre-fix code (queued run cancelled immediately, no belt, no audit).
- `test_smAgent.js` — 5 new/rewritten cases: defer on queued (ghost-window replay), cancel after materialization, belt concludes only the cancelled run's pending check-runs (App-token swap asserted), multi-run sweep (queued deferred + in_progress cancelled), audit dedupe per head.
- `test_validationLiveness.js` — 4 marker round-trip/parse/degeneracy cases.
- Full suite: **2504 passed, 0 failed**.

### Notes

- Tunables: `jobParams.cancelMaterializeTimeoutMs = 0` restores the legacy cancel-immediately escape hatch.
- Deferral cost: a superseded run may keep occupying the queue until its jobs materialize (one or more ticks) — accepted by design; the gh-842/843 cure-side sweep remains the general ghost backstop.

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# gh-848 — Root Cause Analysis

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The gh-748 twin-guard cancel path (`cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` in `js/smAgent.js`) cancels workflow runs while they are still `queued` (pre-materialization). A queued cancel leaves the run's already-registered check-runs orphaned as `in_progress` ghosts forever — no run exists to re-run, and the tick PAT cannot conclude them via the Checks API (403, verified) — so branch protection holds mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED on dead check-runs indefinitely.

**Root cause**: `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` (js/smAgent.js) selected stale runs (`status === 'queued' | 'in_progress' | 'waiting' | 'pending'`) and issued `gh api -X POST .../actions/runs/<id>/cancel` with no materialization check. A run's check-suite registers at dispatch time (ghost #5: dispatch 21:39:48, check-suite 21:40:01) while the jobs only materialize later; GitHub only concludes a run's check-runs as `cancelled` when jobs exist. Cancel in the queued window = orphaned `in_progress` check-runs (live fa #1457 five ghost cycles, fa #1520, ghosts #4–#6 on 2026-10-10, AFTER the gh-843 cure side went live — the cure detects ghosts but cannot prevent this minter).

**Impact**: Every validated machine PR is at risk. A single duplicate/superseded dispatch cancelled within seconds of its dispatch seizes the merge gate permanently (2h+ operator cost per incident on fa #1457).

**Fix approach** (per ticket capability surface):
1. **Guard** — before `gh run cancel`, poll `gh api .../actions/runs/<id>` until `run.status != 'queued'` (jobs materialized) with a short timeout (`jobParams.cancelMaterializeTimeoutMs`, default 45s; `jobParams.cancelMaterializePollMs`, default 3s). Still queued (or probe degenerate) → DEFER the cancel to the next tick. A materialized cancel marks check-runs `cancelled` — a clean terminal state.
2. **Belt** — after ANY cancel, list the cancelled run's check-runs on its head (`github_get_commit_check_runs`, filtered by backing run id via `checkRunZombies.runIdOf`); any still pending is concluded `cancelled` via the Checks API (`PATCH /check-runs/<id>`) under the GitHub App token swap (`jobParams.silentToken` — PAT 403s, same swap `stampValidationChecksForModule` already uses).
3. **Audit** — one marker comment per head per event (`⏸ ghost-guard defer <sha> — run <id> still queued at <iso>` / `🧹 ghost-guard clean <sha> — <N> orphaned check-run(s) concluded at <iso>`), deduped against existing markers so a head sitting queued across many ticks produces exactly one comment, never one per tick.

**Previous attempt**: none (fresh bug; gh-843 cure side already shipped and intentionally out of scope).
"}

    "    return '\\uD83D\\uDED1 stale-cancel ' + headSha +\n"
    "        ' \\u2014 stale base at ' + (atIso || '');\n"
    "}\n"
    "\n"
    "// ── Ghost-guard markers (gh-848) ───────────────────────────────────────────\n"
    "//\n"
    "// The gh-748 twin-guard cancel path must never cancel a run before its jobs\n"
    "// materialized — a queued cancel orphans the run's already-registered\n"
    "// check-runs as `in_progress` ghosts forever (no run to re-run, no API to\n"
    "// conclude them with the tick PAT) and the merge gate holds on the dead\n"
    "// checks indefinitely (live fa #1457 five ghost cycles / #1520, ghosts\n"
    "// #4-#6, 2026-10-10). One marker line per head records the two ghost-guard\n"
    "// events durably on the PR — same bookkeeping-only contract as the markers\n"
    "// above (gh-846/gh-755 parity: nothing tick-side consumes them; `cancelled`\n"
    "// is never a verdict, no fail-validation / zombie re-dispatch keys on them):\n"
    "//\n"
    "//   ⏸ ghost-guard defer <fullHeadSha> — run <id> still queued at <iso>\n"
    "//   🧹 ghost-guard clean <fullHeadSha> — <N> orphaned check-run(s) concluded at <iso>\n"
    "//\n"
    "// A head can sit queued across MANY ticks before its jobs materialize, and\n"
    "// the audit poster dedupes per (event, head) against these markers — exactly\n"
    "// ONE marker comment per head, never a comment per tick.\n"
    "\n"
    "var GHOST_GUARD_DEFER_RE = /⏸ ghost-guard defer ([0-9a-f]{7,40}) — run (\\d+) still queued at (\\S+)/g;\n"
    "var GHOST_GUARD_CLEAN_RE = /🧹 ghost-guard clean ([0-9a-f]{7,40}) — (\\d+) orphaned check-run\\(s\\) concluded at (\\S+)/g;\n"
    "\n"
    "function ghostGuardDeferMarkerLine(headSha, runId, atIso) {\n"
    "    return '⏸ ghost-guard defer ' + headSha +\n"
    "        ' — run ' + runId + ' still queued at ' + (atIso || '');\n"
    "}\n"
    "\n"
    "function ghostGuardCleanMarkerLine(headSha, count, atIso) {\n"
    "    return '🧹 ghost-guard clean ' + headSha +\n"
    "        ' — ' + count + ' orphaned check-run(s) concluded at ' + (atIso || '');\n"
    "}\n"
    "\n"
    "/**\n"
    " * Aggregate ghost-guard marker lines over comment bodies →\n"
    " * { deferred: { <fullSha>: <newest marker epoch ms> },\n"
    " *   cleaned:  { <fullSha>: <newest marker epoch ms> } }.\n"
    " * The audit poster treats a head already present for an event as recorded —\n"
    " * that is the one-marker-per-head dedupe. Unparsable timestamps degrade to\n"
    " * absent entries (a duplicate marker is audit noise, never a functional\n"
    " * state).\n"
    " */\n"
    "function ghostGuardMarks(bodies) {\n"
    "    var out = { deferred: {}, cleaned: {} };\n"
    "    (bodies || []).forEach(function (body) {\n"

    "        GHOST_GUARD_DEFER_RE.lastIndex = 0;\n"

{"content":"### Root Cause

The gh-748 twin-guard cancel path (`cancelStaleDispatchedRuns`) cancelled stale workflow runs while they were still `queued` (pre-materialization). A run's check-suite registers at dispatch time but jobs materialize later — GitHub only concludes a cancelled run's check-runs `cancelled` when jobs exist. A queued cancel therefore orphans the registered check-runs as `in_progress` ghosts forever (no run to re-run, no API to conclude them with the PAT), seizing mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED (live fa #1457 five ghost cycles, #1520; ghosts #4-#6 on 2026-10-10, after the gh-843 cure side went live).

### Fix

- `js/smAgent.js` — **guard**: before `gh run cancel`, poll `gh api .../actions/runs/<id>` until `status != 'queued'` (jobs materialized) within `jobParams.cancelMaterializeTimeoutMs` (default 45s, poll 3s); still queued or probe-degenerate → **defer** the cancel to the next tick. Probe errors also defer — queue waste is always cheaper than a seized gate.
- `js/smAgent.js` — **belt**: after ANY cancel, list the cancelled run's check-runs on its head (`checkRunZombies.runIdOf` matching); any still pending is concluded `cancelled` via `PATCH /check-runs/<id>` under the GitHub App token swap (`silentToken` — the PAT gets 403, verified), mirroring `stampValidationChecksForModule`.
- `js/smAgent.js` + `js/common/validationLiveness.js` — **audit**: one marker comment per head per event (`⏸ ghost-guard defer …` / `🧹 ghost-guard clean …`), deduped against existing markers so a head queued across many ticks gets exactly one comment. Bookkeeping-only (gh-755 parity: `cancelled` is never a verdict).
- Supersedes the gh-846 same-tick cancel of *queued* runs — AC3 holds: duplicates are still suppressed, just safely.

### Test Coverage

- RED verified: the 4 new reproduction tests FAIL against the pre-fix code (queued run cancelled immediately, no belt, no audit).
- `test_smAgent.js` — 5 new/rewritten cases: defer on queued (ghost-window replay), cancel after materialization, belt concludes only the cancelled run's pending check-runs (App-token swap asserted), multi-run sweep (queued deferred + in_progress cancelled), audit dedupe per head.
- `test_validationLiveness.js` — 4 marker round-trip/parse/degeneracy cases.
- Full suite: **2504 passed, 0 failed**.

### Notes

- Tunables: `jobParams.cancelMaterializeTimeoutMs = 0` restores the legacy cancel-immediately escape hatch.
- Deferral cost: a superseded run may keep occupying the queue until its jobs materialize (one or more ticks) — accepted by design; the gh-842/843 cure-side sweep remains the general ghost backstop.

gh-848 is complete. Summary of the work:

## Root Cause
The gh-748 twin-guard cancel path (`cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` in `js/smAgent.js`) cancelled stale workflow runs while still `queued` (pre-materialization). A run's check-suite registers at dispatch time but GitHub only concludes check-runs `cancelled` when jobs exist — a queued cancel orphans them as `in_progress` ghosts forever, permanently seizing the merge gate (fa #1457: five ghost cycles, 2h+ operator cost; fa #1520; ghosts #4–#6 on 2026-10-10, *after* the gh-843 cure side went live).

## Fix (guard + belt + audit, per the ticket's capability surface)
- **`js/smAgent.js` — guard**: before `gh run cancel`, poll the run until `status != 'queued'` (jobs materialized) within `jobParams.cancelMaterializeTimeoutMs` (default 45s); still queued or probe-degenerate → defer to the next tick. Probe errors also defer — queue waste is always cheaper than a seized gate.
- **`js/smAgent.js` — belt**: after ANY cancel, any of the run's check-runs still pending on its head (matched via `checkRunZombies.runIdOf`) is concluded `cancelled` via `PATCH /check-runs/<id>` under the GitHub App token swap (`silentToken` — the PAT 403s, verified live), mirroring `stampValidationChecksForModule`.
- **`js/smAgent.js` + `js/common/validationLiveness.js` — audit**: one marker comment per head per event (`⏸ ghost-guard defer` / `🧹 ghost-guard clean`), deduped against existing markers — a head sitting queued across many ticks gets exactly one comment, never one per tick.

## TDD evidence
- **RED**: the 4 new reproduction tests fail against the pre-fix code (verified via stash revert).
- **GREEN**: `run_smAgent` 497 passed, `run_validationLiveness` 24 passed, **full suite 2504 passed, 0 failed**.

Deliverables written: `outputs/rca.md` and `outputs/response.md`; only the three intended source/test files are modified (no secrets, `outputs/` already gitignored).
